components.css: :host{--bg:#181818;--panel:#1f2027;--card:#2a2c36;--card-2:#32343f;--line:#33353f;--line-2:#40424e;--text:#fff;--text-2:#c3c6cf;--text-3:#9a9eab;--mint:#87fcc4;--sky:#28c1f5;--mint-soft:rgba(135,252,196,.13);--ok:#57b36a;--ok-soft:rgba(87,179,106,.14);--warn:#f5b54a;--warn-soft:rgba(245,181,74,.13);--danger:#ff6b7a;--danger-soft:rgba(255,107,122,.13);--brand:linear-gradient(92deg,#87fcc4 0%,#28c1f5 98.77%);--radius:12px;--radius-sm:8px;--ease:cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);font-family:Vazirmatn,Tahoma,sans-serif;color:var(--text)} .ds-run{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;font-size:15px;line-height:1.75}.ds-run-head{display:flex;gap:10px;padding:10px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-size:13px;color:var(--text-2)}.ds-run-head b{color:var(--text);font-weight:600}.ds-el{margin-inline-start:auto;color:var(--text-3)}.ds-step{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px 14px;min-height:48px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);cursor:pointer}.ds-step:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.02)}.ds-state{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;flex:none;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1.5px solid var(--line-2);color:var(--text-3)}.ds-state svg{width:14px;height:14px}.ds-done .ds-state{border-color:transparent;background:var(--mint-soft);color:var(--mint)}.ds-running .ds-state{border-color:var(--mint);border-top-color:transparent;animation:ds-spin .9s linear infinite}@keyframes ds-spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}.ds-lbl{flex:1;min-width:0}.ds-lbl b{display:block;font-weight:500}.ds-lbl small{display:block;color:var(--text-3);font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.6}.ds-t{color:var(--text-3);font-size:12.5px;white-space:nowrap}.ds-progress{height:3px;background:var(--line);margin:0 50px 10px 14px;border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden}.ds-progress span{display:block;height:100%;width:60%;background:var(--brand);border-radius:3px}

narrative.northStar: The Console With an Engineer Inside
narrative.overview:
Hamyar wears the Liara console's grammar, measured from console.liara.ir, so the user feels at home before reading a word: a near-black ground, blue-grey panels and cards separated by hairlines, mint for whatever is selected or alive, and the mint-to-sky gradient kept for the one action that moves things forward. The engineer inside shows up as conversation plus a live pipeline. Each agent turn becomes a run card whose steps tick in with elapsed time, and changes stop at an approval card that shows cost, risk and undo.

The system is dense but calm. Depth comes from tone (ground, panel, card, raised card), not from shadow. Colour carries state and rarely decorates: mint means done or selected, amber means waiting for you, coral means broken, sky marks low-risk and informational things. Everything is right-to-left Persian in Vazirmatn, dark only, and built mobile-first at 375px.

Hamyar keeps its own name and mark (a gradient tile with a check stroke). It never uses Liara's logo or claims to be Liara.
keyCharacteristics: Dark only (`color-scheme: dark`), four tonal layers, 1px hairline borders.
Mint as the single "alive / selected" signal; the brand gradient on the primary action, the brand mark and progress fills only.
Vazirmatn 400 to 700, body at 15px / 1.75, proportional Persian digits everywhere.
One SVG icon set with a 1.6px round stroke; no icon fonts and no text glyphs used as icons.
Every control is at least 44px tall and its label never wraps.
Motion is short and settles with a single expo-out ease (`cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`), and stops entirely under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Mint means selected, active or done, and nothing else. A mint element that is not in one of those states is a bug.

rules.name: The Gradient Earns Its Place Rule
rules.body: The Liara gradient goes only on the primary action, the Hamyar mark and progress/confidence fills. Never on text, borders, cards or backgrounds.

rules.name: The State Speaks in Tint Rule
rules.body: State containers use the soft tint background plus a lighter on-tint text or a 0.35 to 0.45 alpha border of the state colour. Never a saturated solid fill.

rules.name: The Proportional Digits Rule
rules.body: Persian numbers (prices, times, percentages, counters) use proportional figures. Never set `tabular-nums` or `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`. The only allowed exception is a grid that truly needs vertical column alignment, scoped to that element alone.

rules.name: The Isolated Latin Rule
rules.body: URLs, code, evidence IDs and file paths sit in an LTR, bidi-isolated span (`direction: ltr; unicode-bidi: isolate`) inside the RTL flow.

rules.name: The One Row Toolbar Rule
rules.body: Toolbar and action rows are `flex flex-wrap items-stretch`. Never a rigid grid that forces one child full-width and leaves a half-width button stranded. Check every such row with 1, 2 and 3 controls at 375px.

rules.name: The 44px Floor Rule
rules.body: Every interactive control (buttons, pill, chips, app switcher, segmented tabs, inputs, the composer field, switches) is at least 44px tall, and controls in one row share a height. Nothing interactive goes below this, including disclosure summaries and banner buttons.

rules.name: The Tone Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: To lift a surface, step it up one tonal layer and give it a hairline. Shadows are kept for things that float above the scroll (the sticky bar and the toast).

dos: Do build every surface from ground, panel and card tones with 1px hairlines before reaching for anything else.
Do keep mint for selected, active and done states, and the Liara gradient for the primary action, the mark and progress fills.
Do show state with soft tints (`mint-soft`, `ok-soft`, `warn-soft`, `danger-soft`) and an alpha border of the same hue.
Do make every control at least 44px with a label that never wraps, and verify every row at 375px with no horizontal overflow.
Do use logical properties (`inset-inline-start`, `margin-inline`, `padding-inline-start`, `text-align: start`) so the layout stays correct in RTL.
Do draw icons from the one inline SVG sprite: 18px default, 1.6px round stroke, `currentColor`.
Do wrap Latin URLs, code and evidence IDs in an LTR, bidi-isolated span.
donts: Don't add a light theme; the system is dark only.
Don't use Liara's logo or present Hamyar as Liara.
Don't put the gradient on text, borders or card backgrounds.
Don't fill state containers with saturated colour; use the soft tint.
Don't add shadows to cards; depth is tonal, and shadows belong only to the sticky bar and the toast.
Don't use a rigid grid for toolbars that strands a half-width button.
